A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 18-page versions of the same MAPLE paper, including Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–18 are identical; page 1 differs only in publication metadata.

before.justification: v2 reports original retrieval experiments and ablations in Section 4, supplementary analyses in Appendix C, and qualitative retrieval results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains the original retrieval experiments, ablations, supplementary analyses and qualitative results reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same retriever architecture, preference construction, pairwise/listwise RPA losses and contrastive regularization. The expanded-negative procedure in Appendix C.1 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same curated OpenImage training data and evaluate on COCO, Flickr30K, Winoground, NaturalBench, MMVP and BiVLC. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same CLIP-based models, E5-V and VladVA variants. The modality-gap comparison in Table 4 and the ablation comparisons also retain identical comparator sets.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain identical model configurations, training budgets, sample sizes, metrics and evaluation procedures, including the 100-instance Winoground sample for modality-gap measurement.

E4.justification: The loss and expanded-negative ablations, balancing-weight sensitivity, caption-sampling study, modality-gap tracking, category breakdowns and qualitative retrieval examples are unchanged in the main text and appendices.

E5.justification: Neither version reports evaluation run/seed counts, confidence intervals, uncertainty error bars or significance tests. Statistical reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 retains MAPLE(Qwen2-VL-7B)'s Winoground Text/Image scores of 56.0/32.7; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The Wasserstein definitions, modality-gap formulation and DPO/RPA mathematical development in Sections 2–3 and Appendix A are identical, including Equations 1–10.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about MLLM alignment priors, the unified Wasserstein metric, MAPLE/RPA contributions and fine-grained retrieval improvements.

C2.justification: Interpretations of regularization, listwise alignment and general versus fine-grained retrieval tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning inherited MLLM biases and the need to validate composed retrieval.

D1.justification: Appendix B and Table 5 retain identical data-curation instructions, prompts, LoRA settings, hardware specifications and training time. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: All 42 references and the related-work discussion in Appendix D are unchanged, including positioning relative to contrastive retrieval and DPO.

P1.justification: The first-page footer changes from 'Preprint. Under review.' to the NeurIPS 2025 conference line. The arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 21 September 2025 to v3 dated 31 December 2025. Research prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: All nine figures and six tables retain identical content, captions, styling and placement. The first-page metadata substitutions occupy the existing footer and margin positions without changing the document layout.

improvement.justification: The only changes are the publication footer and arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and Appendices A–E, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
